julian_day — DRIVE env op

• Data kinds: any → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.julian_day(when) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import driveenv; driveenv.julian_day(when) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("julian_day"))

Usage

Julian day (UT). when = a timezone-aware datetime (converted to UTC), or a number (taken as the Julian day as is).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

素朴な(tzinfo の無い)datetime は 拒否する(地方時と UTC を取り違えると太陽が 9 時間ずれる)。
